description: A sign-in approval flow where a trusted device shows an alert, then a code to enter on the new device.
overview: The screen shows a mock alert from the trusted device with Allow and Don't Allow. Allowing reveals a code and an `InputOTP` to enter it, with a `Spinner` while checking and an error for a wrong code; denying shows a blocked message with an option to show the request again. A correct code shows an approved screen.
usage: `onVerify` receives the code and returns a boolean or a promise; by default it accepts the demo code `482913`. Edit `COPY` to change the text for each phase.
